Subject: Access onboarding orchestration: SSO/SCIM, service accounts, IP allowlist

Hi Alice / Bob,

Thanks for choosing Redwood — excited to get your access controls in place so you can start the pilot next month. To keep the kickoff efficient, here are the pieces we'd like to confirm before the technical session on Thursday: 

- SSO (SAML): entity ID, ACS URL we should expect, and whether you'll host metadata or want us to push. See attached saml-config-template.yaml (attachment).
- SCIM provisioning: primary user identifier (email vs username), group sync cadence, and a sample attribute map. See scim-provisioning-checklist.pdf.
- IP allowlist: list of ACME outbound CIDRs (for admin console access) and any jump boxes.
- Service accounts: naming convention, desired scopes for initial rollout (read-only vs admin for service-to-service calls).
- Org policies: any constraints (max session length, MFA enforcement) we should mirror in the onboarding runbook — draft attached (org-policy-draft.docx).

Please reply with the items you can confirm today so we can pre-populate configs. If you'd prefer, propose a 30-minute window for Thursday (10:00–10:30 or 15:00–15:30 PT) and we'll send a calendar invite.

Quick ask: if procurement needs to be looped for DocuSign, put the right contact on cc.

Thanks,

— Lauren Bishop
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Access onboarding orchestration: SSO/SCIM, service accounts, IP allowlist

Hi Lauren,

Thanks — this is great. Quick answers below: 

- SAML: We'll host metadata at https://idp.acme.com/metadata.xml. Entity ID: https://idp.acme.com. ACS URLs: https://app.redwood.acme.com/saml/consume and the secondary for staging.
- SCIM: Use email as primary identifier. We'd like group.sync daily (0300 UTC). Attribute map: email, givenName, familyName, title, department. (I'll upload a sample CSV to the Drive link after this).
- IP allowlist: We have two egress blocks for admins: 34.88.0.0/16 and 35.192.0.0/12. Will confirm if jump hosts are necessary.
- Service accounts: prefixed acme-rdw-<env>-<svc>. Start with read-only tokens for the first sprint.

We can do Thursday 15:00–15:30 PT — Bob will join for SAML/SCIM specifics. Looping procurement (procurement@acme.com) for contract question.

Best,
Alice
Director, IT Operations
ACME Corp

- Ben: please prepare a short note for procurement about the implementation timeline and any temporary credits we can offer if DocuSign is delayed. Also validate the CIDR blocks with our IP allowlist service; if any overlap or blocking is required, call it out.

Other technical notes to raise on the call: SCIM rate limits (we support up to 500 req/min by default; can raise for enterprise), group-to-role mapping examples, and fallback plan if SCIM attribute mapping fails during the initial sync.

Attachments: saml-config-template.yaml, scim-provisioning-checklist.pdf, org-policy-draft.docx

Thanks — want this prepped by Wednesday EOD so we can demo a working staging flow on Thursday.

— Lauren
